title: The rainbow: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: A rainbow needs sunlight and tiny drops of water.
When light moves from air into water, it bends.
All the colors bend by the same amount.
The light from one raindrop makes a whole rainbow.
To see a rainbow, look toward the raindrops in front of you.
What happened just before the rainbow appeared?
Why do we usually see sunlight as white?
items.why: “Usually, these colors travel together. That is why we see white light.”

items.q: What do scientists call the bending of light?
Where does some of the light reflect inside the raindrop?
options: Off the top of the raindrop
Off the front of the raindrop
Off the back of the raindrop
items.why: “Some of the light reflects off the back of the raindrop.”

items.q: Why does a rainbow look like an arch?
options: Because we usually see only part of a circle
items.why: “From the ground, we usually see only part of that circle.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: A rainbow needs sunlight and tiny drops of water. Inside each raindrop, the sunlight bends, reflects and separates into colors. The light from millions of raindrops makes a big colored arch in the sky.

items.q: Which colors are part of sunlight?
items.model: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet.

items.q: What happens to sunlight inside a raindrop?
items.model: It bends when it enters the drop. Some of it reflects off the back of the drop. It bends again when it leaves, and the colors spread apart.

items.q: What should you do to see a rainbow?
items.model: Look for sunshine while rain is falling in the distance. Stand with the Sun behind you and look toward the raindrops in front of you.

items.q: Have you ever seen a rainbow? Where and when?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the steps in the order of the text.
items: A ray of sunlight enters a raindrop
The light bends as it moves into the water
Some light reflects off the back of the raindrop
The light leaves the drop and bends once more
Colored light from many drops reaches our eyes
